notes:
- Library on an external drive: an unplugged drive no longer breaks Settings — the app names the drive, and reloads by itself when you plug it in
- Incoming: one place to get tracks, say which playlist they're for, and send them to rekordbox
- Spots downloads the collection already has, and keeps the longer edit when that's what arrived
- Crates: gather tracks from any page, and get suggestions for what belongs with them
- Hear a Beatport track before you buy it
- Genres read from the files themselves, and pages that re-read them far less
- Check for problems and its re-download now work, and a long check survives leaving the page
